scope: Eighteenth bounded target-specific wave: eight current completion-unproved Privacy and Finance targets; one direct Documenso deletion-audit recommendation and seven conservative retained-unproved outcomes.

methodology.runtime_boundary: No application, browser, database, deployment or product Git state was changed.
methodology.no_copy_rule: Evidence is behavioural only; do not copy source, schema, UI, wording or distinctive layouts.
methodology.direct_rule: A recommendation requires target-specific neutral job alignment at pinned official community-source loci. Generic fields, adjacent feed controls or family-level source remain unproved.
methodology.reuse_rule: The Documenso query helper inspected during Wave 17 granted no system-wide audit credit. Wave 18 credits only the distinct record-scoped deletion transaction and deletion-event evidence; all shared Privacy and Finance candidates remain explicitly unproved.

DOCUMENSO.edition_boundary: Pinned official community source only; hosted services, private configuration and unpinned behavior are excluded.

CISO_ASSISTANT_COMMUNITY.edition_boundary: Pinned official community source only. The enterprise directory and commercially licensed edition are excluded.

BIGCAPITAL.edition_boundary: Pinned official community source only; hosted services, private configuration, commercial offerings and unpinned behavior are excluded.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Record deletion as an authorized, attributable audit event within the deletion transaction and permit bounded review of that event.
evaluations.research_candidate: documenso/documenso deletion transaction and document audit-log evidence at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: Visibility-aware deletion records DOCUMENT_DELETED in the owning transaction with event type, actor identity, IP and user agent, and authorized record-scoped retrieval exposes the event. This is bounded deletion-audit evidence only, not a system-wide log claim.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Own a legal-hold record through creation, scope, activation, preservation and accountable lifecycle changes.
evaluations.research_candidate: intuitem/ciso-assistant-community privacy model legal/regulatory hold fields at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: A legal/regulatory-hold policy choice and retention string do not establish an owned hold aggregate, lifecycle state, scoped preservation or provenance.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Authorize and record legal-hold release with accountable reason, history and failure/retry semantics.
evaluations.research_candidate: intuitem/ciso-assistant-community privacy model legal/regulatory hold fields at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: The candidate contains no authorized release command, release history, reason, retry or preserved post-release evidence.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Manage a scoped, versioned and accountable retention-policy register with governed changes.
evaluations.research_candidate: intuitem/ciso-assistant-community retention fields at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: A retention string is not a separately owned, scoped, versioned or audited policy register.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Select due retention reviews into an accountable worklist with assignment, completion and escalation semantics.
evaluations.research_candidate: intuitem/ciso-assistant-community retention fields at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: The model does not prove due-item selection, queue ownership, assignment, completion or escalation workflow.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Govern external-to-canonical accounting account mappings through explicit create, update, validation and audit semantics.
evaluations.research_candidate: bigcapitalhq/bigcapital Plaid synchronization mapping at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: Automatic Plaid-to-bank-account mapping is a bank-feed primitive, not an authorized accounting-integration mapping register with CRUD and audit ownership.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Own an accounting integration connection through create, test, pause/resume, failure recovery and disconnect.
evaluations.research_candidate: bigcapitalhq/bigcapital Plaid feed pause, resume and disconnect commands at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: Plaid feed controls do not establish a complete accounting-connection creation, testing, failure and recovery lifecycle.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Run and observe an owned accounting-connection synchronization with bounded state, failures, retry and provenance.
evaluations.research_candidate: bigcapitalhq/bigcapital Plaid refresh and transaction-ingestion source at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: Bank-feed transaction ingestion is not a separately owned accounting-connection synchronization action with state, failure and recovery evidence.
